source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion

steps.instruction: Put 2 cups of papaya chunks in the blender.
Add 2 sliced bananas and 1 cup of yogurt.
Blend on a medium setting for 1 minute, until smooth.
steps.spoken: Blend on a medium setting for about 1 minute, until the ice is chopped and the mixture is smooth.
Serve right away, or cover and refrigerate for up to four hours.
